name: Performance, Accessibility & Security Verification
description: Non-functional quality verification including load/stress testing (k6, JMeter), accessibility compliance (WCAG, axe-core), and basic application security validation. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: In security testing, the QA engineer verifies that known vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10 like SQLi, XSS, CSRF, missing auth headers, IDOR) are checked and blocked during quality gates; this is fundamentally different from Cyber Security's cs_threats_and_attacks where security analysts develop exploit payloads, conduct penetration testing, and analyze attacker TTPs.

subskills.name: Apache JMeter Load Testing
subskills.description: Creating Thread Groups, HTTP Request Samplers, View Results Tree, and basic throughput assertions in Apache JMeter.

subskills.name: Automated Accessibility Testing (WCAG/axe)
subskills.description: Running automated WCAG 2.1 AA audits using axe-core, WAVE, and Lighthouse Accessibility.

subskills.name: k6 Performance as Code
subskills.description: Writing JavaScript load testing scripts in k6 (virtual users, stages, thresholds for p95/p99 latency).

subskills.name: Load, Stress, Spike & Soak Testing
subskills.description: Designing Load, Stress, Spike, Soak (Endurance), and Breakpoint testing profiles.

subskills.name: Resource Monitoring During Load Tests
subskills.description: Correlating load generation with CPU/Memory/I/O bottlenecks and database connection pool saturation.

subskills.name: OWASP Top 10 Quality Gate Verification
subskills.description: Verifying defensive controls against OWASP Top 10 (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, insecure direct object references, missing auth headers).

subskills.name: Distributed Load Testing at Scale
subskills.description: Orchestrating distributed load generators across multi-node clusters in Kubernetes / cloud for high RPS.

subskills.name: Screen Reader & Assistive Tech Auditing
subskills.description: Manual assistive technology verification (NVDA, VoiceOver, keyboard navigation traps).

subskills.name: Performance Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
subskills.description: Conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on performance test failures (identifying thread locks, slow DB queries, memory leaks).

junior.description: Understands core performance testing profiles (load vs stress vs soak), executes baseline JMeter load scripts, and runs automated accessibility audits using axe-core and WAVE.

mid.description: Writes k6 load testing scripts, monitors server resource saturation during load generation, and verifies OWASP Top 10 defenses during quality gates.
